chapter: On the road, Philadelphia and New York
title: Tadd Dameron, Ike Isaacs and Annie Laurie
summary: Dameron played with him around Philadelphia, and Annie Laurie was done to fit the costumes.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: Did Tadd Dameron play with you for a long time?
Yeah -- not a long time, but he played with me.
All around -- Philadelphia, I don't know about New York, we didn't work too much in New York except theater. But yeah he was among them.
Who were some of the other guys who played with you? This was around the late 40's -- early 50's right? The discography lists Ike Isaacs --

Ike Isaacs, that's who I couldn't think of, yeah, from Cleveland, yeah. 'Cause he was married to this girl, Carmen MacRae for a while. He advanced himself. I don't know what happened to him lately. But he was a manager and he was everything.
How did tunes like Annie Laurie go over?
Maxine Sullivan had a big hit with Loch Lomand --
did that have anything to do did that give you any idea to do that sort of thing?
No it didn't give me the idea. I just did mine to fit the costumes.
